title: The union of the closed faces Φ_q([0,1]^{m+1}), q ∈ s, is compact
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let s be a finite set of index pairs q = (ι, b) with ι : Fin (m+1) → Fin P and b : Fin P → ℤ. For q = (ι, b) and y ∈ Euclid (m+1) put Φ_q(y) := b + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)} ∈ ℝ^P. Here b is regarded as the vector WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (b i : ℝ)) and e_l := EuclideanSpace.single l 1. Then Z := {x ∈ ℝ^P : x = Φ_q(y) for some q ∈ s and some y ∈ Euclid (m+1) with 0 ≤ y_i ≤ 1 for every i} is compact.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ))), IsCompact {x : Euclid P | ∃ q ∈ s, ∃ y : Euclid (m + 1), (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (q.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (q.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) = x}
